select pp.project_id, pp.LEASE_ITEM_ID, pp.chance_mp_id, hli.FULL_NAME as LEASE_ITEM_ID_N, hli.LEASE_ITEM_CODE, hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE, (select meaning from sys_code_value_b_v where code = 'HLS.COLLATERAL_TYPE' and code_value = hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE) LEASE_ITEM_TYPE_N, hli.PATTERN, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'HLS.PATTERN' AND code_value = hli.PATTERN ) PATTERN_N, hli.MORTGAGOR, ( SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = hli.MORTGAGOR ) MORTGAGOR_N,
hli.PLEDGE_STATE, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'PLEDGE_STATE0' AND code_value = hli.PLEDGE_STATE ) PLEDGE_STATE_N, (select a.EVALUATION_VALUE from (select hlid.lease_item_id, sum(hlid.EVALUATION_VALUE) as EVALUATION_VALUE from hls_lease_item_detail hlid group by hlid.lease_item_id) a where a.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id) ASSET_VALUE_TOTAL,
(select sum(a.v1+a.v2) FROM (select hlid.lease_item_id, sum(hlid.purchase_price) as v1,sum(hlid.pledge_asset_value) as v2 FROM hls_lease_item_detail hlid group by hlid.lease_item_id) a WHERE a.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id) ORIGINAL_ASSET_VALUE_TOTAL from prj_project_chance_mp pp,hls_lease_item hli
hli.LEASE_ITEM_ID = pp.LEASE_ITEM_ID and hli.enabled_flag = 'Y' and hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE in ('MORTGAGE','PLEDGE') and pp.project_id = #{projectId}
